resources.string: Printer status with a filament scan shortcut

string-array.name: widget_idle_quips
string-array.item: I\'ll be back. After this print. Maybe.
Hasta la vista, print errors.
One does not simply level a bed.
All g-code and no printing makes Bambu a dull boy.
I find your lack of filament disturbing.
Do or do not. There is no warp.
It\'s a trap! The bed was never leveled.
Houston, we have nothing. The plate is empty.
You\'re gonna need a bigger build plate.
Why so serious? The plate is empty, relax.
If you slice it, it will warp.
Are you not entertained? No? Fine, I\'m idle.
King of the world! Ruler of an empty plate.
Frankly, my dear, I don\'t give a clog.
Life is like a box of filament: you never know what\'ll warp.
The first rule of Print Club: we don\'t print right now.
Freedom! Zero layers, total freedom.
There is no spool.
I know g-code. I just won\'t run it.
The print is a lie.
I used to print like you, then I took a clog to the nozzle.
Idle. Idle never changes.
Would you kindly slice a model?
Press F to pay respects to the last failed print.
This is fine. The bed is cold and empty.
Task failed successfully: no print started.
It ain\'t printing, but it\'s honest idling.
I am once again asking you to slice a model.
All your bed are belong to dust.
Wind\'s howling. Bed\'s cold.
Winter is coming. Your print is not.
You know nothing, Jon Slow.
I am the one who clogs.
Say my filament.
Never gonna print you up, never gonna let you cool down.
Beam me up, nothing\'s printing down here.
Resistance is futile. So is printing today.
Live long and procrastinate.
